messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: abnormal page-in/sec and IO stalls on serving pool redwood-prod-gpu, variant=awq-int8, severity=P2. continuous-batching backlog rising. paging symptoms triggered. paging-alert -> oncall @irene_oncall

irene_oncall: picking up. handoff to this thread. any customer alerts?

karen_support: seeing customer-facing 504s for two tenants (DataFold + HealthOps). Start times ~2026-03-20T18:40Z. I'll collate logs and open customer notices.

sam_eng_runtime: metrics: p99 token latency jump ~6x for AWQ-int8. KV cache resident per-shard increased from ~600MB -> ~1.9GB after the kernel registry bump yesterday morning. Batcher queue depth correlated with page-ins.

maya_ml: I sampled the cache layout: AWQ path appears to be producing KV keys with 32-bit alignment and padding for some attention heads due to a dtype selection change. Effective per-token KV size increased ~2.8x for sequences ~512. Suspect allocator+kernel selector interaction.

nate_sre: impacted hosts: prod-gpu-7, prod-gpu-8, prod-gpu-9. IO wait and swap-in spikes on those. I'll isolate traffic and consider local runtime overrides.

irene_oncall: mitigation steps: (A) divert AWQ-int8 traffic to gptq stable variants where possible, (B) apply runtime env override on affected hosts to force compact uint8 KV packing, (C) temporarily lower continuous-batcher max_batch_size and max_queue_ms for AWQ routes, (D) prepare rollback of the kernel registry change if override insufficient.

ops-bot: routing action queued by @sam_eng_runtime: create temporary route mapping AWQ-int8 -> gptq-fallback for production clusters. canary 5%.

sam_eng_runtime: canary live, routing ~5% of traffic off AWQ-int8. monitoring traces now.

karen_support: DataFold on canary shows errors drop to normal. Sending interim update.

nate_sre: applying host override:
``
echo "REDWOOD_FORCE_KV_PACK=uint8_compact" > /etc/redwood/env/kv_pack && systemctl restart redwood-runtime
```

ops-bot: command executed on [prod-gpu-7,prod-gpu-8,prod-gpu-9] by @nate_sre

nate_sre: post-restart stats: prod-gpu-7 resident 2.1GB->0.78GB, prod-gpu-8 1.9GB->0.74GB, prod-gpu-9 2.0GB->0.77GB. page faults dropped ~80%. p99 latency for rerouted/canary traffic now within SLO (~250ms).

sam_eng_runtime: rolling routing change to 100% in stages (20% -> 60% -> 100%).

deploy-bot: routing-rollout stage=20% -> OK

deploy-bot: routing-rollout stage=60% -> OK

deploy-bot: routing-rollout stage=100% -> OK

irene_oncall: smoke tests across embeddings and chat endpoints look stable. marking customer-impact mitigated. keeping thread open for remediation + handoff.

maya_ml: root-cause hypothesis: a recent change in kernel registration (commit 2026-03-19T23:50Z) changed default dtype selection for certain AWQ kernels when built with the new allocator flags, causing a fallback to 32-bit-aligned KV layouts. This increases memory footprint and breaks continuous-batching assumptions.

sam_eng_runtime: action: add temporary guard in routing config to prefer gptq for prod until a kernel selector patch is landed. Also will add a canary step for kernel registry changes.

nate_sre: monitoring additions: set alert kv_resident_host > 1.0GB -> page oncall + autoscale. also applying batcher limits cluster-wide for AWQ routes: max_batch_size=56, max_queue_ms=40.

karen_support: sent incident notice to affected accounts: DataFold, HealthOps. compiling impact table for PMs.

maya_ml: opened PR to force compact uint8 packing and add a kernel-selector assertion: https://git.redwood.ai/ml-runtime/PR-501. Running CI perf matrix including AWQ-int8, gptq, and awq-compact. Early local runs show per-token KV returns to ~0.6KB from ~1.7KB on 512-seq workloads.

sam_eng_runtime: postmortem checklist: record kernel registry commit, allocator flag change, lack of canary for kernel selection, continuous-batcher assumptions, customer impact timeline, and the host override patch we used.

alex_platform: recommend adding a CI gate that checks KV cache footprint and a blocked deploy if regressions exceed 20% for known quant paths. Opening infra ticket.

mj_oncall: I'll take monitoring + handoff for the next shift. leaving note: keep override in place until PR lands and CI is green, then coordinate a staged rollout of the kernel selector change. Handoff at 2026-03-21T04:00Z to @mj_oncall.

irene_oncall: summary: mitigated via routing + host overrides + batcher throttles. PR open and in CI. customers notified. follow-ups assigned. closing active mitigation. file postmortem and link.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: id=1775128842 status=mitigated severity=P2 assignees=[maya_ml,sam_eng_runtime,nate_sre] thread_ts=1775128842
